messages:
morgan: Heads-up — respawned a backfill job for EU aggregates (job id 0x7f2c). It hit a quarantine after a bunch of shards failed validation. Need a quick ops/console sync so we can surface progress properly to PMs. :eyes:

ashley: what failed validation? checksum mismatch or missing source files?

morgan: checksum + late-s3-partitions. A few source partitions showed 0 bytes for the hour window, then reappeared later. replay-bot status shows partial writes then tombstones.

replay-bot: job 0x7f2c status: RUNNING (respawned)
  completed_shards: 42/310
  quarantined_shards: 7
  last_error: "kv-merge-failure on shard eu-14"

kai: could we surface quarantined_shards in the console progress bar? right now stakeholders only see a single progress % which looks stuck.

ashley: yes — ops needs to mark "quarantine" vs "in-flight" so PMs don't panic. also need ETA estimate that excludes quarantined shards unless we decide to auto-retry.

morgan: proposal: show three metrics in console UI for replays — in_flight, completed, quarantined — and an "effective ETA" that assumes quarantined are preempted and retried on a different pass.

kai: UX question — do we show estimated cost delta if we re-run quarantined shards in a high-priority lane? PMs ask about cost impact when we preempt normal work.

ashley: yep, show an optional expanded view with estimated token/compute cost and a toggle to "escalate quarantined shards (inc cost)". default off.

morgan: operationally, I'm worried about runaway respawns. We should cap auto-respawn attempts to 2 and then surface an "operator action required" state.

ops-oncall: +1 on cap. Also ask for a ledger entry per respawn attempt so we can audit who/what triggered it.

ashley: ledger idea is good — we can append a small event to the job metadata: {attempt, trigger, timestamp, reason}. can be a shallow map, just strings.

kai: snippet for the runbook command we used to respawn:
```
# respawn quarantined shards on job 0x7f2c into priority lane
replayctl respawn --job 0x7f2c --shards eu-14,eu-19 --priority high --max-attempts 2
```

morgan: logs from the bad shard: 
```
2026-03-21T12:11:02Z shard eu-14: read source s3://telemetry-prod/events/2026/03/21/12/ -> 0 bytes
2026-03-21T12:11:05Z shard eu-14: later write detected, checksum mismatch, kv-merge-failure
2026-03-21T12:11:06Z shard eu-14: tombstone created, moved to quarantine queue
```

sana: quick question — is the quarantine queue processed by the same backfill workers or a separate quarantine handler?

morgan: separate handler for safety. that's what prevented cascade restarts. but our console doesn't expose that distinction.

ashley: action items I can take: 1) add console fields for quarantined/in-flight/completed + expand view for cost; 2) add small ledger event schema for respawn attempts; 3) wire an operator flag to force-respawn from UI (with audit). ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow for #1/#2 (backend + small UI).

kai: I'll add a conservative default ETA calc in the API: effective_eta = remaining_in_flight * avg_shard_time. quarantined_shards flagged separately so UI shows a warning badge.

morgan: ops question — if we escalate quarantined shards into high-priority lane, do we preempt normal replays or run in parallel (burst)?

ops-oncall: prefer preempt with a short cool-down to avoid thermal/resource overcommit. we can do parallel if cluster headroom > 20%. Need a metric in console showing headroom % before allowing escalation.

ashley: will add headroom check in UI, grey-out escalate toggle if headroom < 20% and show tooltip: "escalation blocked: compute headroom < 20%".

morgan: decision for this incident: respawned only the 2 smallest quarantined shards into priority lane, capped attempts=1 for now. ops will monitor.

replay-bot: job 0x7f2c update: 2 shards respawned into priority lane. attempts_remaining for those shards: 1

kai: small API tweak request: add a boolean job_metadata.show_quarantine_in_progress so console teams can opt-in per job. default true for telemetry reprocess jobs, false for normal ad-hoc replays.

ashley: agree — we'll default to true for scheduled telemetry backfills. I'll include this in the PR.

sana: follow-up: do we want automatic alerting when quarantined_shards > 5% of total? ops-oncall: yes, set a pager threshold at 8% and a slack warning at 3%.

morgan: ok locking that in: pager if quarantined_shards_fraction >= 0.08 for > 10m; slack alert at >= 0.03 for > 5m. kai, add the metric to the telemetry dashboard?

kai: done — added metric tile "replay.quarantined_fraction" and ETA badge. I'll push to staging dashboard now.

ashley: will post a short blurb in #product to calm PMs, linking to the new console view once deployed.

ops-oncall: monitoring note — if we see repeat checksum mismatches on same partition ranges, raise an ingest pipeline ticket.

morgan: thanks all. if anyone sees the job regress, ping me and I'll escalate to infra. :rocket:
